newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil B Band winners to boost foreign reserves.
newsitem.headline: Brazil B Band winners to boost foreign reserves.

text.p: Brazilian foreign reserves shrunk in June by about $1.7 billion to $57.59 billion, but are expected to increase again in July as a result of foreign investment by the new operators of Sao Paulo's B Band cellular services, a newspaper said.

The BCP SA consortium led by BellSouth Corp of the United States won the cellular telephone concession for the Sao Paulo metropolitan area with a $2.45 billion bid, nearly four times the minimum price of 600 million reais.
Market players estimate the BCP consortium will bring around $1 billion in foreign investment in the next 20 days, Gazeta Mercantil said.
In May, Brazilian foreign reserves stood at $59.28 billion, Gazeta said.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
